Nudge on iOS Booking Detail

Staff looking at an overdue checkout on their phone can now remind the borrower without switching to the web dashboard.

Overdue checkout, staff view

Same fixture, device, appearance and scroll. The baseline was captured from an isolated HEAD worktree with only the fixture and test harness files copied in; BookingDetailView and APIClient are the pre-change source. Clock is relative to launch, so the minute shown differs by one.

Bottom action bar

Volleyball vs Nebraska, two hours overdue.

After a tap

After-only: the baseline has no Nudge to tap. Captured in the same UI test run against the fixture's stubbed nudge route.

What changed, and why

Nudge was web-only

Was

Only the web dashboard's overdue banner could send a nudge; the iOS app had no call to the nudge route.

Now

Booking Detail shows Nudge for an open, past-due checkout when the server grants the nudge action. That hides it from Students and from shared travel-case checkouts.

Clear sending and sent states

Was

Not applicable on iOS.

Now

The button shows a spinner while sending, then a green Nudge Sent confirmation, and ignores further taps. Failures, including the server's return grace period, show inline under the booking.

Nobody could see who already nudged

Was

The sent state lived in one screen's memory; a reload or a second staff member saw a fresh Nudge button.

Now

Dashboard overdue rows and booking detail read the latest nudge from the audit log: "Nudged 20m ago by Erik". Within the hour the button shows as sent. Shared travel-case checkouts no longer offer Nudge on the web banner.

Verification

  • BookingNudgeScreenshotUITests.testOverdueNudgeCaptures passed on the iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator: Nudge rendered, the tap reached the sent state.
  • Baseline testOverdueNudgeBaselineCaptures passed in the isolated worktree.
  • Wisconsin simulator build succeeded; tests/ios-booking-nudge-contract.test.ts passes (3 tests).
  • tests/nudge-history.test.ts (6) plus the full vitest suite: 700 files pass after updating two Extend-label contracts.

Things to know

  • Fixture captures prove presentation only. Not verified: a real nudge against the API as Staff, push delivery to the borrower, or the grace-period error on a device.
  • Home still lists only the viewer's own checkouts; staff reach this screen from Bookings or the Overdue report.
  • The web overdue banner change was not browser-verified; it needs an authenticated dev:preview session with an overdue checkout.
